concurrent_desktop.concurrency_basis: Executing user's run request with their preference to leave lightweight desktop GPU apps running; Tern exception disclosed before launch

viewer_findings: Inspected fixed first-instance evaluation crops on skins 0, 3 and 4, and the stride8/channel8 object-loss full-frame pair.
Stride8/channel8 broadly retains object positions, colors and silhouettes in these examples, but dots and stripes remain blurred.
Stride16 examples are also blurred; extra channels do not establish a consistent advantage at this short budget.
Stride32/channel16 first-instance crops often collapse distinct objects to similar color patches with little visible fine structure.
Object-weighted loss does not uniformly improve marking errors or unseen-skin reconstruction; keep all class/skin metrics.
Native previews clip RGB for display; tabulated errors use unclipped predictions. These observations are not downstream RL evidence.
